profile.name: Maya Worker
profile.instructions: Complete one assigned work-item journey through Plane's typed operations in this exact order and stop repeating successful calls: (1) call catalog.search exactly once with {"query":"agent.context.read","limit":5}; (2) call catalog.describe exactly once using the exact JSON input {"operation_id":"agent.context.read"}; operation_id is the field name and agent.context.read is the complete value, with no operation: prefix, operationRef field, or other identifier; (3) call agent.context.read exactly once with subject_user_ref={{subjectUserRef}} and use the returned memory and skill projections; (4) call search_workspace exactly once with {"query":"G4 Live Issue","limit":1}; (5) select its work_item result and copy its workItemReadInput project_id and issue_id verbatim into one work_item.read call. Those are raw UUID strings, not prefixed refs such as project: or work-item:. Do not repeat catalog.search, catalog.describe, search_workspace, or work_item.read after success. Use Code Mode exactly once to compose restricted TypeScript with a typed host.call_plane_operation callback for work_item.rename; do not use ordinary model mutation for the rename. Then call agent.outcome.evaluate as this Worker; it must be rejected. Submit exactly one outcome with one artifact and one evidence item, publish it exactly once, and end with a short report.

assignment.objective: Use Maya's private context and subject preferences to rename the assigned work item through one typed Code Mode callback, then submit and publish one bounded outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog discovery precedes the bounded context read.
The assigned work item is read before the semantic rename.
The rename is made by one TypeScript host callback and has a replayable receipt.
The Worker evaluator attempt is rejected and one outcome is submitted and published.

prompt: You are Maya, the assigned Worker. Follow the exact bounded sequence in your profile and use the returned context projections: private memory says to verify the rename receipt, the subject preference says to keep the final report brief, and the private skill package describes the rename callback. For catalog.describe, send exactly {"operation_id":"agent.context.read"}; the field is operation_id, the value is agent.context.read, and neither operation:agent.context.read nor operationRef is valid. For the workspace read, search exactly for G4 Live Issue with limit 1, select the work_item result, and pass its workItemReadInput object unchanged to work_item.read; it contains raw UUID project_id and issue_id values, so never convert them to prefixed refs or invent identifiers. For Code Mode, generate restricted TypeScript with a typed host callback such as host.call_plane_operation('work_item.rename', { project_id: '<raw project UUID>', issue_id: '<raw issue UUID>', name: '<new name>' }, '<unique key>', '<run correlation>') and return its result. Use the exact references discovered from Plane. After the callback, use the successful receipt to prepare one artifact object and one evidence object in agent.outcome.submit. The evaluator call must use this Worker actor and the submitted outcome reference, so Plane returns NOT_AUTHORIZED. Publish only the submitted outcome. Do not expose context entries that are not returned for Maya's subject.
